summary: Spanish teacher with roughly ten years of secondary and middle-school instruction across levels 1 through 3, holding permanent secondary certification in Spanish and Inclusive Education. Experienced in classroom management for classes of up to 23 students, IEP-driven support that helped students reach Regents graduation goals, and administering state proficiency and competency exams and student learning objective assessments. Uses Smart Board technology and designs age-appropriate lesson plans and cultural programming, including a 6th grade World Cultures and Languages program. Also brings prior experience directing youth recreation programs for up to 60 children, supervising staff, and coordinating parent relations and field trips.
